jeg_vr_compat.config.title: JEG x Vivecraft: options
jeg_vr_compat.config.grabZone.hip.toolti: Bring the free hand to the hip on its side and press the grip to take a magazine.
jeg_vr_compat.config.grabZone.front.tool: For playing seated with tracked controllers: take the magazine in front of the belly, on the free hand's side.
jeg_vr_compat.config.grabZone.off.toolti: No reloading by hand. The reload key and the secondary button still reload.
jeg_vr_compat.config.showGuides.tooltip: Shows the coloured boxes of the hip, the magazine and the foregrip. Also: /jegvr zones.
jeg_vr_compat.config.hudPlacement.vivecr: The hand or wrist HUD stays where Vivecraft puts it, even if the gun covers it.
Slides the HUD towards the elbow so the gun does not cover it.
jeg_vr_compat.config.hudPlacement.forear: Lays the hotbar along the inner side of the forearm; turn the wrist to see it.
jeg_vr_compat.config.mirrorLeftHand.tool: Guns in the left controller look made for the left hand (bolt and ejection port on the other side), animation included.
jeg_vr_compat.config.bowLaser.tooltip: While drawing the compound bow, a laser follows the arrow's predicted flight (32 blocks, transparent towards the tip).
jeg_vr_compat.config.gunHud.tooltip: Each gun's name, ammo and meters float beside its hand, instead of JEG's overlay on the HUD.
jeg_vr_compat.config.handsFollowAnimatio: The hands let go of the controllers during the guns' animations, and the controller carries the gun with a delay. Off: they always stay with the controllers.
jeg_vr_compat.config.hudExclusion: Hotbar on the hand with listed guns
jeg_vr_compat.config.hudExclusion.toolti: With one of the listed guns in the off hand, the hotbar stays on the back of the hand, wherever the option above puts it for other guns.
jeg_vr_compat.config.hudExcludedGuns.too: Item ids separated by commas, for example jeg:minigun, jeg:flamethrower
